name: German Voice
desc:
Welcome to German Voice!

Join a fun and friendly space where you can connect with others, chat comfortably, and let your voice be heard! Whether you're here to enjoy great talks, share what’s on your mind, or just chill and make friends, German Voice is the perfect spot for you.

👍🏼 Like the game to stay updated on new features and updates!
⚠️ If you encounter toxic players or exploiters, feel free to report them on our community server.

🔊 (VC) Voice chat is highly recommended, but not required!
⭐ VR is supported!

⚠️ DISCLAIMER ⚠️
We are not responsible for any actions taken by other players during or outside of this experience. To report an issue or incident, please join our Community Server and submit a support ticket.

scripts.title: TLMenu V3
scripts.features:
TLMENU v3.0 | German Voice | Universal

Universal script with German Voice support, custom themes, and utility features.

 Features
- Themes: One Piece, Dragonball, The Boys, Dexter (Music & Backgrounds).
- German Voice: Compatibility for hangout remote events.
- Actions: Sync-emotes (Hug, Carry, Piggyback, etc...).
- Fly & Speed: 4 speed modes, 5 fly styles, Walkspeed/Jumppower.
- Combat: Aimbot, Silent Aim, and FOV circle.
- Visuals: ESP, custom cursors, and particle effects.
- Safety: Anti-Void, Anti-Fling, and Staff Detector (Audio alert).
- Utility: Outfit Stealer (German Voice only), Rejoin, and Serverhop.

 Keybind
- Press K to toggle. Settings auto-save.
